scenes.text: Imagine standing in a room so quiet that you can hear your own blood pumping through your veins.
This is the quietest place on Earth, a specialized chamber that absorbs ninety-nine point nine percent of all sound.
Without any external noise, your brain desperately starts searching for sound and actually begins to hallucinate.
Most people can’t stand being inside for more than forty-five minutes before they start losing their grip on reality.
